paper: SHARP: A Self-Evolving Human-Auditable Rubric Policy for Financial Trading Agents
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock analogue of SHARP's predicted-return-times-confidence score and bounded attribution-mutation-validation rubric loop; not the missing LLM analysts, prompts, news cache, final evolved rubrics, daily action ledger, or native empirical path.

paper_source.bounded_release_search_checked_2026_09_0: The paper supplies no implementation URL; the cited dataset repository and owner return 404, and exact repository, code, commit, and Hugging Face searches found no attributable SHARP release.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: The analyst emits predicted return, confidence, and activated rule IDs; predicted return times confidence is ranked cross-sectionally.
A bounded condition-action rubric exposes an audit trail and evolves through attribution, atomic mutation, and held-out validation.
Five rounds diagnose the 20 worst training observations, propose no more than three edits, accept within a 50 bp validation tolerance, and retain the strictly best rubric for testing.

Six shared initial rules encode temporal discounting, catalyst weighting, broad-market filtering, high-fear damping, and low-information confidence caps; representative evolved diffs change individual thresholds or weights.

initial_rubric.condition: same-sign extreme one-month move and catalyst
high attention without fundamental catalyst confirmation
signal follows the market while idiosyncratic catalyst is weak
high trailing cross-sectional volatility and bullish prediction

evolution_policy.mutation_operator: For each recurrent rule on the 20 worst training months, evaluate one bounded step up and down; retain its better strictly tail-improving atomic edit, combine at most three by tail gain, and apply the paper's validation gate.
evolution_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: predicted return times confidence under the frozen best rubric enters the fixed value-weighted long-short deciles and all six common paths

preserved_elements: explicit condition-action rubric with rule IDs and categories
worst-tail attribution rather than average-error prompting
recurrence filter for systematic failure patterns
at most three mutations per round
held-out validation gate with 50 bp tolerance
strictly best rubric frozen for out-of-sample testing
cross-sectional long-short ranking and next-period execution
approximated_elements: JKP price, accounting-surprise, quality, attention, and volatility characteristics replace daily price, Finnhub news, and macro text
six deterministic JKP conditions replace the LLM-interpreted shared initial rubric
monthly 48/12/24 windows preserve the paper's 4/1/2 train-validation-test proportions
worst months replace worst trading days
counterfactual tail-return gains replace LLM attribution diagnoses
bounded one-step parameter edits replace natural-language rule mutations
common value-weighted deciles replace daily equal-weight 5-long/5-short holdings
invented_elements: the exact base analyst feature weights and confidence formula
all condition thresholds mapping unavailable news and macro state to JKP
10 bp inner-loop cost aligned to the common benchmark
